bridgeRouteRisk.summary: The five catalogued native deployments use Portal burn/mint and LayerZero V2. On Ethereum, Arbitrum, Monad and Base, fresh pins confirm the shared 3-of-5 Safe v1.4.1 as Portal admin and owner of both bridge ProxyAdmins, empty Safe modules, zero guard and a present fallback handler. A separately identified operator key can change adapter peers and chain mappings and pause Portal, so the Safe is not the only bridge authority. Current peers and two-required-DVN settings are verified on the Ethereum/Arbitrum/Monad triangle, Ethereum/Base pair and Ethereum/0G pair. The 0G deployment has a different single-key bridge administrator/upgrade owner. Signing independence, fallback execution safeguards and enforced upgrade delay remain unresolved.
